findings.title: The MODIFIED Emit-timing block retains the unqualified 'no emit fires for that session' limitation — contradicted by the begin emit for first sessions
findings.recommendation: The Known-limitation paragraph (line 69) and the 'User abandons conversation without explicit signal' scenario (lines 95-97) still say 'no emit fires for that session'. With the begin emit, a FIRST session that scaffolds and dies always has one emit (the begin) — only the BOUNDARY emit is missed. Qualify both: the limitation becomes 'no BOUNDARY emit fires for that session (a first session's begin emit still recorded the workstream's start)'; the scenario's THEN likewise. Same-class as the un-delta'd-enumeration CRITICALs of prior cycles, caught inside the change's own composed block.

findings.title: Bare --json shape unspecified when the degradation ladder falls back to the full view
findings.recommendation: The continuity requirement says zero live workstreams → bare renders the --full view; the JSON requirement defines distinct shapes per tier. One sentence should state that bare --json in the fallback state emits the FULL shape ({program, workstreams, last, waiting}) — the natural reading, but two implementers could split (full shape vs sprint shape with nulls).

findings.title: Conventions staging-dir creation scenario becomes non-exhaustive again (begin emit adds .orbit-runs/ at creation)
findings.recommendation: The 'Created by explore in named/crystallized modes' scenario (extended at D2 to name explore.md + .openspec.yaml) will omit the begin emit's .orbit-runs/ after D3. Non-contradictory (not an exclusive claim) — the same judgment call as the D2-cycle finding. Either (A) add a small orbit-conventions MODIFIED block extending the scenario's THEN with the begin emit, or (B) leave it non-exhaustive as was chosen for the run-summary-emit mentions last cycle.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: Add an orbit-conventions MODIFIED block extending the creation scenario with the begin emit (delta grows to 12 requirements; fingerprint re-stamp)

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: Leave the scenario non-exhaustive (accurate, non-exclusive) — consistent with last cycle's option-A scope choice which extended conventions only because it was already modified

The trail is not edited (audit policy) — this review JSON records the correction for downstream readers; no artifact fix required.
